text.p: Vallen Corp said on Tuesday that it and Emergency Response Strike Team Inc, a unit of Unocal Corp, have formed an alliance to provide emergency response management and supply services to customers throughout North America.
Emergency Response is a provider of emergency management services to manufacturers, oil companies, chemical companies, municipalities and other organizations.
Vallen, through its subsidiary Vallen Safety Supply Co, provides safety supplies and emergency response equipment to companies.
The new venture pools services provided by each of the two companies and provides enhanced services and support to a wider array of organizations, Vallen said.
